store.name: TaskFace: Reminders on Watch
store.subtitle: Your to-dos on the watch face
store.promo: Raise your wrist and see what's next. TaskFace keeps your top reminders and upcoming events on your Apple Watch face — always visible, always in sync.
store.whatsNew:
• Now in 16 languages
• Checked off a reminder on Apple Watch by mistake? You have 5 seconds to undo
• Events stay on the face for 1 hour after they start
• All-day events fill spare lines (you can turn this off)
• Holidays are no longer shown
store.description:
TaskFace keeps the top items of the built-in Reminders app on your Apple Watch face, all the time.

Just raise your wrist to see what to do next. Your reminders stay where they are: adding with Siri, syncing across devices and viewing in the Reminders app all work as before.

■ On your watch face
• Shows your top reminders (up to 4 lines) in a watch face complication
• Supported faces: Modular, Modular Compact, Infograph Modular
• Show upcoming calendar events too. Choose how many lines, and how many of them are for events
• Events stay for 1 hour after they start. All-day events fill spare lines. Holidays are not shown
• 15 colors for reminders and events

■ Arrange on iPhone
• Drag to reorder — the order is saved as the priority in Reminders itself
• Add, complete and rename right in TaskFace. Changes go to your watch face instantly
• Check off an item on Apple Watch and you have 5 seconds to undo
• A Home Screen widget shows the same list

■ Always up to date
• Set up one Shortcuts automation to refresh the face whenever you close Reminders, and you're done
• Tap the complication to update it on the spot

■ Your data
• Uses only the reminders and calendars on your iPhone. The app stores nothing of its own
• No account. No ads. No analytics
• The only in-app purchase is a tip to buy the developer a coffee. It changes nothing

Requires an iPhone paired with an Apple Watch.
